'''New Plympto''' was a temperate terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region populated by [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]]. It was discovered by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] around [[10,000 BBY]] - although the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] apparently had contact with it since at least [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], using the native population as potential recruits. The planet was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]]. Its capital was the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phemiss]].

==History==
[[File:FightingonNewPlympto.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Fighting on New Plympto after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], New Plympto was welcomed into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a source of [[rikknit egg]]s, the Nosaurians' chief export. However, they were denied representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and eventually grew alienated. Soon enough, the market for rikknit eggs evaporated and New Plympto was, for all intents and purposes, abandoned by commercial interests.

With the outbreak of the Clone Wars, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] recruited New Plympto to their cause with the promise of reviving the rikknit egg market and rebuilding the planet's economy. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dass Jennir]] led a battalion of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on New Plympto [[Battle of New Plympto (Clone Wars)|against]] the Nosaurian rebels but Jennir sought refuge with the Nosaurians after his clone troops received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[Hajial Chase]], an old stretch of forest 400 km from Phemiss and surrounding woodlands served as shelter to renegade Nosaurians.

Following the Clone Wars, New Plympto begrudgingly became an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] world. The [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]] was quickly and easily [[Cleansing of New Plympto|quashed]] by the Nosaurians' new Imperial masters. The Empire soon [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the population. An Imperial governor ruled the planet from a facility on [[Karsten Moon]], where corporate scientists conducted experiments to synthesize the drug called [[ji rikknit]] from a few captive [[Rikknit/Legends|rikknit]] species, though their best result was an inferior narcotic with harmful side effects.

The planet continued to be under Imperial control until the defeat of the Empire and the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

[[File:Exactor.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The [[Exactor/Legends|''Exactor'']] and a swarm of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighters]] over New Plympto in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].]]
Before the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] took control of the planet, it had a population of about fifteen million living on its surface. When the Yuuzhan Vong attacked, a [[New Plympto resistance (Yuuzhan Vong War)|resistance movement]] under [[Numa Rar]] was formed. The Yuuzhan Vong grew tired of the fierce resistance on the planet and used a biological weapon on New Plympto, killing seven million on the surface. The planet was rendered uninhabitable.

Following the war, the planet was declared as a memorial, along with worlds such as [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] and [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]].
